body.text: Reactivity control in normal operation and AOOs is through power runback performed by RMC and CTC.

body.text: RMC and CRD control maximum rod withdrawal speed to limit the reactivity insertion rate.

body.text: There is no direct communication from NIC systems to the RPS.

body.text: The RPS sends data through a one-way data diode to the plant data highway, through an RPS-NIC gateway.

body.text: Hardwired signals use an isolation device.
body.anchor: an isolation device is provided to ensure that the NIC does not have an adverse impact on the RPS

body.text: Where diversity is required, redundant sensors are used: one for SR, one for NSRST or NST.
